page.layout: Two columns of text: a narrow left margin column of marginal notes, and a central column of names by year. Year numbers stand in the right margin beside the groups of names. Page number at the top centre.

main_text.l: Trifiis denuo victis[?] ab Alberto, & Staverâ omniq; regione trans Lavicâ occupata, nobiles quidam Cillavicani agrum omnē Cislavicanum, inconsulto populo, eidē dederūt, & in feudū ab eodē rcceperunt. * Frederick van Arle.
Rursum episc. Blanchem. amicè pacifcitur cum civitate, civitasq; ab Alberto Bavaro obsidetur. Everdt Sicking.1400
Idem episc. bellum infert civitati. Iohan Reiners.

page.notes: The left marginal notes are set in a smaller type and are partly damaged. The first note's word "victis" is read from a ligature-like form ("vi&is") and is doubtful. The years 1398–1404 are in the right margin, each beside its group of names; the group boundaries are marked by rules in the scan. The asterisk before "Frederick van Arle" is printed. The lines are transcribed in order per year group; the placement of the left notes within the lines is approximate.
